tasks.title: Implement PUT and DELETE /forge/webhook
steps: Write TS-32-1 … TS-32-10 against a real secrets store on in-memory SQLite, a recording emitter (copy recordingEmitter from internal/sandboxes/testhelpers_test.go) and apikit.SetAuthInfo; confirm they fail

Create internal/forge/webhook_handlers.go; register PUT and DELETE /workspaces/:slug/forge/webhook in forge.RegisterRoutes using the existing authorize helper with canWriteForge (401, 403 naming forge:write, wsaccess 404)

PUT: after auth, reject non-active workspaces with 400 'workspace is not active' BEFORE reading the body; then parse the optional body (absent, {}, secret null => generate 32 crypto/rand bytes hex-encoded; non-object or non-string secret => 400)
Validate a supplied secret as 16..255 printable ASCII '!'..'~'; the 400 message names 'secret' and the rule and never repeats the value

Store: try UpdateSecret; on *secrets.NotFoundError CreateSecrets; on *secrets.ConflictError retry UpdateSecret once; plain scope-full error => 400 with the store message; any other error => 500; no audit event on failure

Respond 200 {configured:true,url:<webhookURL or null>} and add 'secret' only when generated; emit hub.forge.webhook.set with metadata exactly {generated: bool} via Config.Audit (nil check, context.WithoutCancel, slog on error)

DELETE: same auth order without the active check; DeleteSecret, treat *secrets.NotFoundError as existed=false, other errors 500; emit hub.forge.webhook.unset {existed: bool}; answer 204 with empty body
Neither route reads the target query parameter
done_when: the secret value is never logged or put in audit metadata

tasks.title: Build the public ingress: lookup, verification, body cap, delivery identity, repository binding and recording
steps: Write the listed tests: a helper that builds an Echo root with the ingress mounted, real in-memory SQLite (workspaces table, secrets, forge_deliveries), a recording emitter, a signing helper and a transport that fails on any forge request; confirm they fail
Create internal/forge/ingress.go with MountWebhookIngress(e *echo.Echo, cfg Config) registering POST /hooks/forge/:slug on the Echo root (no bearer auth, no wslock, no forge client)

Step 1 lookup: load workspace row (git_url, workspace_mode, upstream_url) and Secrets.GetSecretValue('workspace', slug, FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) on every request with no cache; unknown slug and NotFoundError both answer the same 404 bytes; any other error 500; status is ignored
Step 2-3 scheme: X-Hub-Signature-256 present => GitHub; else X-Gitlab-Token => GitLab, compared with crypto/subtle before reading the body; neither => 401 before the body is read
Step 4 body: read with a 1 MiB cap (io.LimitReader n+1 and map http.MaxBytesError to 413); handler's own 413 uses apikit.WriteAPIErrorWithType error_type body_too_large

Step 5 GitHub signature: header must be sha256= plus 64 hex digits, compared with hmac.Equal against HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body; every failure answers 401 'delivery signature missing or invalid', logs slog.Warn with only slug and scheme, writes no row and emits nothing

Read delivery id (X-GitHub-Delivery; GitLab Idempotency-Key else X-Gitlab-Event-UUID) and event name (X-GitHub-Event / X-Gitlab-Event); missing, id >255 chars or non-printable-ASCII => 400 with nothing recorded; cut event to 64 bytes

Add a reducer entry point (reduce.go): parse the JSON object, take the repository path (repository.full_name / project.path_with_namespace), compare ignoring case with origin owner/name parsed from git_url (use the spec-30 describeRemote helper) and, on carry_patch with upstream_url, upstream; start with the GitHub issues events so relayed outcomes work

Insert the delivery row (workspace_slug, delivery_id, forge, event, action, target, outcome, relayed JSON array, received_at apikit.NowUTC()) and answer 202 {outcome}; emit events in order after the answer (Task 5 hardens duplicate and failure paths)
done_when: a request without an Authorization header reaches the handler

tasks.title: Harden ingress deduplication, answer-then-relay, malformed/ignored/mismatch outcomes
steps: Write the listed tests (TS-32-47 uses httptest.NewServer and an emitter whose Emit blocks; TS-32-28 posts 1..20 concurrent copies) and confirm they fail
Insert with INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and use RowsAffected: 0 => answer 202 {outcome:duplicate} and emit nothing; insert error => 500 via apikit.WriteAPIError and emit nothing

Outcomes: body not a JSON object or missing required field => record outcome malformed and answer 400; unmapped event/action => outcome ignored (202); relayed kinds with no repository match, unparseable remote, upstream on a standard workspace or carry_patch without upstream_url => outcome repository_mismatch with NULL target (202)

Answer 202 {outcome: relayed|ignored|repository_mismatch}: write the JSON and flush the response (http.Flusher via c.Response()) before emitting; relayed means at least one event handed to the emitter
Emit events in order through Config.Audit with context.WithoutCancel; on an Emit error slog.Error and continue with the remaining events; the answer and row are unchanged
Verify rotation (TS-32-21): rotate through PUT /forge/webhook and confirm old signature 401, new 202 (no caching)

tasks.title: Implement the GitLab mapping and verify relay to SSE and audit query
steps: Write the listed tests; TS-32-48 uses real DuckDB (audit.OpenDB, audit.InitSchema), audit.NewEmitterWithBroadcast, SSEManager and audit.RegisterAuditQueryRoutes with an open /events?workspace=widgets stream; confirm they fail
Create internal/forge/reduce_gitlab.go: Issue Hook open/close/reopen; Confidential Issue Hook and Confidential Note Hook ignored; number is object_attributes.iid

Issue Hook update: edited when changes has title or description, then one unlabeled per label in changes.labels.previous not in current, then one labeled per label in current not in previous, each group sorted by name (label names from title); no change => ignored

Note Hook with noteable_type Issue or MergeRequest and action absent/create => comment.created (number from issue.iid or merge_request.iid, pull_request true for MR, comment_url from object_attributes.url); other noteables ignored
Merge Request Hook open/close/reopen/merge => opened/closed/reopened/merged; update with oldrev => synchronize, without oldrev => ignored; Push Hook and Tag Push Hook => push (ResourceID the ref)
Actor from user.username or user_username; project.path_with_namespace for binding; reuse the shared event builder from task 6
Verify events emitted in production order reach hub_audit_events, GET /audit and the SSE stream
